answer_1.quote: We propose ADQA, a multiple-choice QA framework ... to evaluate AD generation methods ...

answer_2.quote: Classically, ADs are evaluated using CIDEr which compares n-grams between the generated and reference ADs. ... we also report BERT similarity, R@k/N, CRITIC, LLM-AD-Eval, Action Score, SegEval.

answer_3.quote: We use a common prompt and LLM (Gemini 2.0 Flash) to perform all evaluations in our work. ... The LLM is prompted to answer each question independently and to provide a rationale indicating whether the answer was derived from the context.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation with 8 participants covering both question generation and answering stages. ... participants judged (i) whether the answer options were valid, (ii) whether the question was clear and answerable, (iii) whether the answering rationale was grounded in the context, and (iv) whether the chosen answer followed from the rationale.
answer_4.guideline: Participants judged validity of generated questions, answer options, rationales, and answer correctness.
